related.gloss: to take care of, to see to

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.

Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

meanings.en: actually, as a matter of fact, for the record

examples.text: Меня вообще-то Юля зовут. Вот сахар.
examples.trans: My name is actually Yulia. Here's the sugar.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Neuter главное, used as a noun.
Neuter главное, used as a noun.

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
The most important thing is the people.

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

дорабатывать.gloss: to refine, to rework, to improve

meanings.en: to refine, to rework, to improve on

examples.text: Не смей никогда дорабатывать мои блюда!
examples.trans: Never dare to modify my dishes!

examples.text: Тогда и будешь свои блюда дорабатывать!
examples.trans: Then you can modify your own dishes!

доработать.gloss: to refine, to improve, to finish working on

meanings.en: to refine, to improve, to finish working on

examples.text: Шеф, а мы с Катей доработали соус Лаврова!
examples.trans: Chef, Katya and I have improved Lavrov's sauce!

examples.text: Вообще-то я его немного сам доработал.
examples.trans: Actually, I tweaked it a bit myself.

жалко.gloss: feel sorry for; it's a pity

meanings.note: impersonal predicate (+ dative of experiencer, + accusative/genitive)

examples.trans: I just feel sorry for him.

examples.text: Что за глупость? Эдик, мне его просто жалко.
examples.trans: What nonsense is that? Edik, I just feel sorry for him.
Edik, I just feel sorry for him.

meanings.note: забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.note: verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?
emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Ты только что разрушил свою карьеру.
examples.trans: You have just destroyed your own career.
Your political career is already over.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.
It's easy for you to say.

examples.text: Да это легко. Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Come on, it's easy. Grab the little dog in the park and run.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: А зачем? Я сам сделал так, чтобы он его написал.
examples.trans: And why would I? I'm the one who made him write it.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

обойтись.gloss: to manage without, do without; to turn out

meanings.en: to get by without, manage without
всё обошлось = everything turned out fine

examples.trans: Try to manage without our help.
We will easily manage without a car.

examples.text: Постарайтесь обойтись без нашей помощи. — Спасибо вам огромное!
examples.trans: Try to manage without our help. — Thank you so much!

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

examples.text: Да, я наведу здесь железный порядок.
examples.trans: Yes, I'll establish iron order here.

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

следить.gloss: to watch, to follow; to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to look after, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: Keep an eye on the child.

examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

examples.text: Никто не смеет оскорблять мою высокую кухню!
examples.trans: Nobody dares insult my haute cuisine!
Don't you dare talk like that.

Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Мы танцевали. Сначала они там грубили, оскорбляли.
examples.trans: We were dancing. First they were rude and insulting over there.

examples.text: Ты слишком сентиментальным стал. А лидер должен быть жёстким.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
